title: DOT Academy — Explore your experience
description: Read Book One and explore Digital Organism Theory through its concept map, open questions, and your own experience.
heading: Become a student of your own experience.
introduction: Read a passage, bring it back to a moment you know, and talk through what fits or remains unclear. Understanding can develop through that exchange; agreement is not a condition for taking part.
inquiryIntroduction: A useful question can be specific: ‘When I felt dismissed, what was happening in my body, and what did my past add to the moment?’ Bring your own example, an unclear term, or a disagreement.
conversationDescription: Tell Henok which passage or experience you would like to talk through.
